guard: manager-caller exchange selection is unique, remote-manager precedence is fail-closed, and the selected instance is server-authored
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm smoke:remote-exchange:live

mutations.name: two live remote manager candidates select the first instead of refusing ambiguity
mutations.find:
if (remoteLive.length > 1)
      throw new Error(`manager-caller selection found ${remoteLive.length} live remote manager candidates for owner ${owner}; exactly one is required or name --manager-instance`);
mutations.expectRed: two live remote managers refuse and name the count
mutations.note: The absent selector must never choose by enumeration order when several owner-bound managers are live.

mutations.name: an unavailable owner remote manager falls through to the co-located manager
mutations.find:
if (remoteInstances.length > 0)
      throw new Error(`the remote manager for owner ${owner} is unavailable (${remoteInstances.length} gate${remoteInstances.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}, none live); pass managerInstanceId to select an instance explicitly rather than falling through to the local manager`);
mutations.replace:
if (remoteInstances.length > 0 && localCandidate === undefined)
      throw new Error(`the remote manager for owner ${owner} is unavailable`);
mutations.expectRed: an unavailable owner remote manager refuses with the explicit-selector remedy instead of falling through local
mutations.note: Any owner-specific remote gate establishes precedence even when it is frozen, retired, or deregistered.
